_note: Phase 38 — the golden-chart harness. Time-INVARIANT judged meaning pinned for five reference nativities. Age-dependent fields (lord of the year, profection house) are deliberately excluded, since they drift with today's date. A change to any pinned value means the ENGINE'S INTERPRETATION drifted — investigate before accepting. Regenerate only on a deliberate doctrine change, and record why.

doctrineChanges.change: peregrine is the neutral no-dignity case, never a second charge on top of a debility
doctrineChanges.why: essentialOf9 set out.peregrine from have9.length===0 alone, so a planet in its detriment or fall was ALSO marked peregrine and Lilly's essential column charged it twice (-5 debility plus -5 peregrine). The app's own label logic already treats them as alternatives (a detriment planet is labelled Detriment, never Peregrine) and its own gloss calls peregrine 'neither helped nor harmed by its sign', which cannot be true of a planet in its fall. Lilly's debilities are alternatives on one table, not cumulative.
doctrineChanges.effect: Only planets in detriment or fall change, each by exactly +5 essential. Across the five reference nativities exactly one judged verdict moved: B.h10 withheld -> promised, because its lord Mercury in Sagittarius (detriment) went from -10 to -5 essential, taking its Lilly total from -2 to +3 and across the >=3 threshold at which a house-lord can pay.

doctrineChanges.change: judgment runs on Lilly's own condition bands, and a malefic CONJUNCT a house lord counts as an affliction
doctrineChanges.why: Two defects, found while making the four testimonies visible as a weighing. (1) The engine had grown an invented threshold at +3 alongside Lilly's published bands (commanding >=10, sound >=5, mixed >=0, strained >=-5, afflicted below), so a lord at net +4 was declared able to pay while the ledger printed under it read 'mixed'. Once each testimony shows the figure it was read from, words that disagree with the figure are visible as a contradiction. leanOf9() now derives every lean and every favour increment from the bands: sound or better favours, below zero opposes, mixed is genuinely mixed. (2) judgeHouse counted malefic squares and oppositions to the house lord but passed over the conjunction, which the tradition treats as the heaviest affliction of the three — Mars sitting on the lord of the 7th registered as nothing at all. judgeTopic already counted it; the two functions disagreed.
doctrineChanges.effect: B.h7 promised -> taxed (Mars conjunct the 7th lord now counts, so harms exceeds helps). B.h10 promised -> withheld and C.h1 promised -> repaired (both lords sat in the +3..+4 window that the invented threshold had let through as able to pay, and Lilly's bands put them in 'mixed'). No other pinned value moves.

doctrineChanges.change: Lilly's ledger now charges the two reception rows his table actually prints, and the kernel reads the birth instant instead of the day after it
doctrineChanges.why: TWO SEPARATE FINDINGS, verified against their sources. (1) Christian Astrology's table of essential dignities opens 'If a Planet be in his own House, OR IN MUTUALL RECEPTION with another by house - 5. In his Exaltation, OR IN RECEPTION BY EXALTATION - 4.' The app computed reception everywhere else in the reading and never brought it to the ledger, so two planets each standing in ground the other rules - the configuration the tradition cites for why a square between them resolves rather than festers - were each scored bare strangers at -5. Reception is a title on this table, so it also suppresses the peregrine charge, on the same principle that already stops a planet in its fall being charged twice. A mixed exchange (one leg by house, one by exaltation) is graded by the weaker leg at 4, the conservative reading. (2) Applying/separating was decided by stepping a pair a WHOLE DAY of birth-speed motion and asking whether the orb had shrunk, which inverts the answer for any fast pair that perfects and overshoots inside 24 hours; measured over 1749 aspects against an independent seven-minute finite difference, the old method got 161 wrong (9.2%), almost all of them Moon contacts. Daily motion and the retrograde flag came from the same forward difference and are now centred on the birth instant (worst error 0.115 deg/day to 0.000026). Sect was read from the Sun's house NUMBER, exact for quadrant systems but wrong in whole-sign, where a Sun already risen can sit in house 1; it is now measured against the horizon arc directly. North and South Node came from different sources, so on the default setting the two nodes drawn were not opposite each other.
doctrineChanges.effect: Only two pinned values move, both by exactly the +4 of one reception row, and neither crosses a band boundary so no verdict changes. A: Venus in Taurus, captain of a Libra Ascendant, is in mutual reception by exaltation with the Moon in Pisces (Venus exalts in Pisces; the Moon exalts in Taurus) - Lilly total 11 to 15. B: Mars in Pisces, captain of a Scorpio Ascendant, exchanges with Jupiter in Capricorn (Mars in Jupiter's own sign; Jupiter in Mars's exaltation) - Lilly total 16 to 20. The applying/separating correction changes no pinned value because none of the five reference nativities pins an aspect flag; its effect is on the aspect and transit prose, covered by tests/kernel.cjs.

doctrineChanges.change: the promise-lean of every testimony now comes from the ZODIACAL state, not from Lilly's blended net total, and a fifth house-verdict named 'carried' covers the thin promise that circumstance is carrying
doctrineChanges.why: MEASURED, not argued. Over 2,100 planet-ledgers across 300 charts: the essential column has mean +0.32 and median 0 - effectively zero-centred - while the accidental column has mean +6.50 and median +7, because nine of Lilly's twelve houses score positive and only three negative, before direct motion, swiftness, increasing light and freedom from the beams are added. Taking each testimony's plus-or-minus off the BLENDED total therefore returned 'favours the matter' 60.7% of the time against 20.3% adverse: a three-to-one thumb on the scale, per testimony, compounding across three or four testimonies per domain. The visible result was judgeMoney calling 33 of 49 sample charts well-promised - flattery wearing a ledger. The fix is the school's own first rule (Morin's etat celeste against etat terrestre, doctrine-notes 1): the SIGN says what a significator can promise, the house says only under what circumstances it must deliver. promiseLean9 reads the zodiacal state alone - major dignity or Lilly's reception-by-house favours, detriment or fall opposes, a stranger or a thin claim (triplicity, term, face, borrowed exaltation standing) is neutral - and returns 23.5% favour / 55.5% neutral / 21.0% against, symmetric as a zero-centred judgment should be. Lilly's blended total keeps both of its real jobs: it is the figure printed in every receipt and the band spoken in the prose. It no longer decides whether a testimony favours the matter. Reception is tested BEFORE the peregrine branch, because reception is a title and the ledger already stops charging peregrine when it finds one - the lean has to agree with the ledger it prints. SECOND FINDING, exposed by the first: with the lean now zodiacal, a lord holding only a term or a face fell straight through to 'withheld', which asserts the lord is too weak to pay at all - a real misreading when that same lord is angular, direct and free of the beams. 'Carried' is that case said honestly, and it is exactly what the state/circumstance split implies: a matter decided by where the significator stands rather than by what it owns.
doctrineChanges.effect: Domain verdicts across a 49-chart spread move from money 33 well-promised / 13 mixed / 3 hard-won to 18 / 26 / 5, with 'mixed' the plurality in every domain, as the tradition expects. Four pinned house verdicts take the new middle verdict: B.h1 promised -> carried (Mars with triplicity and borrowed exaltation standing, accidental +13), C.h1 repaired -> carried, C.h7 withheld -> carried, D.h1 promised -> carried (Mercury holding only a term in Capricorn, accidental +13). A.h10 stays promised: the Moon there is peregrine by sign but in mutual reception by house with Jupiter, which the ledger credits at 5 and the lean now credits too.
